#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic conference poster — VERSION 3 (full A0 canvas fill)
The Lancet Digital Health – AI in Clinical Medicine Symposium
Design philosophy: Clinical Cartography
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
W = 3370
H = 4764

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG         = (10, 18, 36)
NAVY_MID   = (14, 26, 50)
NAVY_LIGHT = (20, 36, 64)
TEAL       = (0, 172, 172)
TEAL_DIM   = (0, 100, 110)
TEAL_DARK  = (0, 50, 60)
GOLD       = (215, 168, 55)
GOLD_DIM   = (130, 100, 32)
WHITE      = (242, 246, 250)
LGREY      = (148, 168, 188)
MGREY      = (68, 90, 115)
DGREY      = (24, 40, 62)
BAR_AI     = (0, 172, 172)
BAR_CLIN   = (42, 74, 116)
WARN       = (195, 62, 62)
WARN_BG    = (42, 10, 10)

def F(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def tw(d, text, font):
    bb = d.textbbox((0,0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2]-bb[0]

def wrap(d, text, x, y, max_w, font, color, lh, draw=True):
    words = text.split()
    line = ""
    for w in words:
        test = (line + " " + w).strip()
        if tw(d, test, font) <= max_w:
            line = test
        else:
            if line and draw:
                d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
            y += lh
            line = w
    if line and draw:
        d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
    if line:
        y += lh
    return y

def R(d, x1,y1,x2,y2,fill):
    d.rectangle([x1,y1,x2,y2], fill=fill)

def rule(d, x1, y, x2, color=None, h=2):
    R(d, x1, y, x2, y+h, color or DGREY)

def ctxt(d, text, cx, y, font, color):
    w = tw(d, text, font)
    d.text((cx - w//2, y), text, font=font, fill=color)

def sec_header(d, lx, ly, label, color=TEAL, accent=TEAL):
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+6, ly+54, accent)
    d.text((lx+20, ly), label, font=f_sec, fill=color)
    rule(d, lx, ly+64, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    return ly + 82

# ── Fonts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_venue   = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",  32)
f_h1      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf",   160)
f_h2      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  80)
f_h2i     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",   56)
f_sec     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   54)
f_sec_sm  = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   42)
f_body    = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",40)
f_body_sm = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",34)
f_body_xs = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",30)
f_mono    = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   34)
f_mono_sm = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   27)
f_mono_b  = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      48)
f_mono_b2 = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      40)
f_big     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",  310)
f_big2    = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",  200)
f_label   = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",36)
f_label_b = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   36)
f_tag     = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   25)
f_tag_sm  = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   21)

M  = 140
GS = 72
CW = (W - 2*M - GS) // 2
C1 = M
C2 = M + CW + GS

def make():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    d   = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # Subtle grid substrate
    for gx in range(0, W, 60):
        R(d, gx, 0, gx+1, H, (15, 25, 46))
    for gy in range(0, H, 60):
        R(d, 0, gy, W, gy+1, (15, 25, 46))

    # =========================================================
    # HEADER BAND
    # =========================================================
    R(d, 0, 0, W, 10, TEAL)

    y = 60
    d.text((M, y),
           "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM",
           font=f_venue, fill=TEAL)
    y += 56

    d.text((M, y), "Artificial Intelligence in", font=f_h1, fill=WHITE)
    y += 170
    d.text((M, y), "Clinical Decision-Making", font=f_h1, fill=TEAL)
    y += 176

    d.text((M, y), "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps",
           font=f_h2, fill=LGREY)
    y += 94

    d.text((M, y),
           "A synthesis of current evidence across >400 peer-reviewed studies on AI-assisted clinical decision support",
           font=f_h2i, fill=MGREY)
    y += 72

    rule(d, M, y, W-M, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    y += 40

    # =========================================================
    # ANCHOR STAT — <5% — full-width hero block
    # =========================================================
    ah = 420
    R(d, M-10, y-10, W-M+10, y+ah, NAVY_MID)
    R(d, M-10, y-10, M+5,    y+ah, GOLD)  # gold accent bar

    # Giant number
    d.text((M+36, y - 30), "<5%", font=f_big, fill=GOLD)

    # Descriptor to right
    dx = M + 36 + 700
    dy = y + 36
    d.text((dx, dy), "of published AI models", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 90
    d.text((dx, dy), "have undergone prospective", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 90
    d.text((dx, dy), "clinical validation", font=f_h2, fill=TEAL)
    dy += 102
    d.text((dx, dy),
           "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML medical devices  ·  fewer than 35 prospectively validated",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=LGREY)

    # Subtle horizontal scan lines inside block
    for sy in range(y+4, y+ah-4, 22):
        R(d, M+36, sy, W-M-10, sy+1, (0, 28, 38))

    y += ah + 6
    rule(d, M-10, y, W-M+10, GOLD_DIM, 2)
    y += 48

    # =========================================================
    # TWO-COLUMN BODY
    # =========================================================
    col_top = y

    # vertical separator (draw last to avoid overwriting)
    sep_x = C2 - GS//2

    # ── LEFT COLUMN ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    lx = C1
    ly = col_top

    # § 01 Background
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+6, ly+54, TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly), "01  BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, lx, ly+66, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ly += 88

    for para in [
        ("The integration of AI into clinical decision-making represents one of the most "
         "rapidly evolving frontiers in digital health. Despite promising results in "
         "controlled research settings, translation into routine clinical practice "
         "remains fundamentally limited."),
        ("This synthesis reviews evidence from a systematic assessment of >400 published "
         "studies evaluating AI-assisted diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic decision "
         "support across major clinical domains, published in The Lancet Digital Health."),
    ]:
        ly = wrap(d, para, lx, ly, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 48)
        ly += 26

    ly += 36

    # § 02 Diagnostic Performance
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+6, ly+54, TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly), "02  DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, lx, ly+66, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ly += 88

    # Paired sensitivity callouts — bigger
    bw = (CW - 30) // 2
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+bw, ly+200, (0, 38, 58))
    d.text((lx+20, ly+2), "87.5%", font=f_big2, fill=TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly+158), "AI Sensitivity", font=f_label_b, fill=TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly+176), "median, n>400 studies", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL_DIM)

    bx2 = lx + bw + 30
    R(d, bx2, ly, bx2+bw, ly+200, NAVY_LIGHT)
    d.text((bx2+20, ly+2), "78.2%", font=f_big2, fill=LGREY)
    d.text((bx2+20, ly+158), "Clinician Sensitivity", font=f_label_b, fill=LGREY)
    d.text((bx2+20, ly+176), "median, clinician-only", font=f_tag, fill=MGREY)
    ly += 220

    d.text((lx, ly), "+9.3 percentage-point diagnostic sensitivity gain",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=MGREY)
    ly += 54

    # Domain bar chart — taller bars, more breathing room
    domains = [
        ("Radiology",     89.3, 79.8),
        ("Dermatology",   86.7, 76.5),
        ("Ophthalmology", 90.1, 82.3),
        ("Pathology",     84.0, 74.1),
    ]
    lbl_w = 170
    bar_area = CW - lbl_w - 100
    scale = bar_area / 100.0
    BH = 26   # bar height
    BG2 = 10  # gap between paired bars

    for name, ai_v, cl_v in domains:
        d.text((lx, ly+4), name, font=f_label, fill=LGREY)
        bx = lx + lbl_w
        # clinician
        R(d, bx, ly, bx + int(cl_v*scale), ly + BH, BAR_CLIN)
        # ai
        R(d, bx, ly+BH+BG2, bx + int(ai_v*scale), ly+BH*2+BG2, BAR_AI)
        # values
        d.text((bx + int(ai_v*scale)+10, ly+BH+BG2),
               f"{ai_v}%", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL)
        d.text((bx + int(cl_v*scale)+10, ly),
               f"{cl_v}%", font=f_tag, fill=LGREY)
        ly += BH*2 + BG2 + 48

    # Legend
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+22, ly+14, BAR_AI)
    d.text((lx+30, ly-2), "AI-assisted", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL)
    R(d, lx+190, ly, lx+212, ly+14, BAR_CLIN)
    d.text((lx+220, ly-2), "Clinician-only", font=f_tag, fill=LGREY)
    ly += 44

    d.text((lx, ly), "Specificity: AI 93.1%  vs.  Clinician 91.4%",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=MGREY)
    ly += 52

    # Turnaround strip
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+CW, ly+70, TEAL_DARK)
    d.text((lx+20, ly+14),
           "↓ 32%    Reduction in diagnostic turnaround time",
           font=f_body, fill=TEAL)
    ly += 90

    left_bottom = ly

    # ── RIGHT COLUMN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    rx = C2
    ry = col_top

    # § 03 Safety
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+6, ry+54, WARN)
    d.text((rx+20, ry), "03  SAFETY, BIAS & EQUITY", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+66, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 88

    # 18% warning block
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+CW, ry+200, WARN_BG)
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+6,  ry+200, WARN)
    d.text((rx+22, ry - 16), "18%", font=f_big2, fill=WARN)
    d.text((rx+22, ry+152),
           "of studies reported any formal demographic bias assessment",
           font=f_label_b, fill=LGREY)
    ry += 220

    for para in [
        ("Among studies that did assess bias, performance disparities of 5–12 percentage "
         "points in sensitivity were documented for underrepresented populations — most "
         "strikingly in dermatology AI trained predominantly on lighter skin tones."),
        ("Adverse safety events attributable to AI recommendations were reported in <1% "
         "of prospective trials. Under-reporting is strongly suspected. No standardised "
         "safety-reporting framework for AI-CDSS currently exists."),
    ]:
        ry = wrap(d, para, rx, ry, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 48)
        ry += 26

    ry += 36

    # § 04 Implementation Gap
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+6, ry+54, GOLD)
    d.text((rx+20, ry), "04  TRANSLATIONAL GAP", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+66, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 88

    ry = wrap(d,
        "As of 2023, the FDA had cleared 692 AI/ML-enabled medical devices — yet "
        "fewer than 5% of peer-reviewed AI models have been prospectively validated "
        "in real-world clinical settings. This structural disconnect between publication "
        "volume and bedside deployment defines the translational crisis.",
        rx, ry, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 48)
    ry += 30

    barriers = [
        ("Data infrastructure",    "Fragmented EHR systems · lack of interoperability standards"),
        ("Regulatory uncertainty",  "Evolving frameworks that lag the pace of AI development"),
        ("Clinician trust",         "Insufficient explainability and transparency of model outputs"),
        ("Economic evidence",       "Limited cost-effectiveness analyses to justify investment"),
        ("Workflow integration",    "Poor alignment of AI tools with existing clinical workflows"),
    ]
    for title, desc in barriers:
        R(d, rx, ry, rx+3, ry+94, GOLD_DIM)
        d.text((rx+18, ry), title, font=f_sec_sm, fill=WHITE)
        ry += 48
        ry = wrap(d, desc, rx+18, ry, CW-20, f_body_sm, LGREY, 42)
        ry += 18

    ry += 34

    # § 05 Recommendations
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+6, ry+54, TEAL)
    d.text((rx+20, ry), "05  RECOMMENDATIONS", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+66, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 88

    recs = [
        ("R1", "Mandate prospective validation",
         "Multi-site, diverse-population trials required before clinical deployment"),
        ("R2", "Standardise bias auditing",
         "Demographic-stratified performance reporting as a mandatory publication requirement"),
        ("R3", "Shared safety registries",
         "Pharmacovigilance-analogous frameworks for AI-CDSS adverse event reporting"),
        ("R4", "Invest in interoperability",
         "Adopt open data standards: FHIR, OMOP across health system infrastructure"),
        ("R5", "Prioritise explainability",
         "Model transparency research to build clinician and patient trust in AI-augmented care"),
    ]
    for num, title, desc in recs:
        d.text((rx, ry), num, font=f_mono_b2, fill=GOLD)
        d.text((rx+74, ry), title, font=f_sec_sm, fill=WHITE)
        ry += 50
        ry = wrap(d, desc, rx+74, ry, CW-76, f_body_sm, LGREY, 42)
        ry += 18

    right_bottom = ry

    # ── Column separator ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    body_bottom = max(left_bottom, right_bottom) + 40
    R(d, sep_x, col_top, sep_x+1, body_bottom, DGREY)

    # =========================================================
    # FULL-WIDTH CLOSING QUOTE / CALL-TO-ACTION BAND
    # =========================================================
    cta_top = body_bottom + 40
    cta_h = 200
    R(d, M-10, cta_top, W-M+10, cta_top+cta_h, NAVY_MID)
    R(d, M-10, cta_top, M+5,    cta_top+cta_h, TEAL)
    rule(d, M-10, cta_top, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    quote = (
        "Closing the gap between AI research promise and clinical reality requires "
        "coordinated action across the research, regulatory, and healthcare delivery ecosystem."
    )
    ql = M + 36
    qy = cta_top + 30
    wrap(d, quote, ql, qy, W - 2*M - 46, f_h2i, LGREY, 72)

    rule(d, M-10, cta_top+cta_h, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    # =========================================================
    # BOTTOM METRICS STRIP
    # =========================================================
    strip_top = cta_top + cta_h + 50
    rule(d, M-10, strip_top, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    strip_top += 36

    metrics = [
        ("<5%",   "Prospective\nvalidation rate",       GOLD),
        ("87.5%", "AI diagnostic\nsensitivity",         TEAL),
        ("78.2%", "Clinician\nsensitivity",              LGREY),
        ("18%",   "Bias\nassessment\nreported",          WARN),
        ("32%↓",  "Turnaround\ntime reduction",          TEAL),
        ("692",   "FDA-cleared\nAI/ML devices",          LGREY),
    ]
    n = len(metrics)
    cell_w = (W - 2*M) // n
    for i, (val, lbl, col) in enumerate(metrics):
        cx = M + i*cell_w + cell_w//2
        if i > 0:
            R(d, M + i*cell_w, strip_top-10, M + i*cell_w+1, strip_top+220, DGREY)
        ctxt(d, val, cx, strip_top+10, f_mono_b, col)
        for j, line in enumerate(lbl.split("\n")):
            ctxt(d, line, cx, strip_top + 74 + j*32, f_tag, LGREY)

    strip_bottom = strip_top + 220

    rule(d, M-10, strip_bottom, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    # =========================================================
    # FOOTER
    # =========================================================
    foot_y = strip_bottom + 24
    d.text((M, foot_y),
           "Lancet Digital Health  ·  2023  ·  Systematic Review  ·  n > 400 studies",
           font=f_tag_sm, fill=MGREY)
    fr = "For research and educational use only"
    d.text((W - M - tw(d, fr, f_tag_sm), foot_y), fr, font=f_tag_sm, fill=MGREY)

    # =========================================================
    # DECORATIVE — Clinical Cartography
    # =========================================================
    # Concentric circles upper-right (data lens)
    cx0, cy0 = W - 180, 360
    for r, density in [(420, 3), (320, 3), (220, 4), (130, 5)]:
        steps = max(600, int(2 * math.pi * r / density))
        for s in range(steps):
            ang = 2 * math.pi * s / steps
            px = int(cx0 + r * math.cos(ang))
            py = int(cy0 + r * math.sin(ang))
            if 0 <= px < W and 0 <= py < H:
                d.point((px, py), fill=TEAL_DIM)

    # Thin horizontal scan lines inside anchor block
    for sy in range(col_top - 300, col_top - 300 + 420, 22):
        if sy > 0:
            R(d, M+36, sy, W-M-10, sy+1, (0, 25, 36))

    # Bottom teal bar
    R(d, 0, H-10, W, H, TEAL)

    return img, strip_bottom

if __name__ == "__main__":
    poster, sb = make()
    # Crop to used content + footer margin
    crop_bottom = min(sb + 110, H)
    cropped = poster.crop((0, 0, W, crop_bottom))
    out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
    cropped.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Saved: {out}  ({cropped.width} x {cropped.height})  strip_bottom={sb}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic conference poster — VERSION 3 (full A0 canvas fill)
The Lancet Digital Health – AI in Clinical Medicine Symposium
Design philosophy: Clinical Cartography
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
W = 3370
H = 4764

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG         = (10, 18, 36)
NAVY_MID   = (14, 26, 50)
NAVY_LIGHT = (20, 36, 64)
TEAL       = (0, 172, 172)
TEAL_DIM   = (0, 100, 110)
TEAL_DARK  = (0, 50, 60)
GOLD       = (215, 168, 55)
GOLD_DIM   = (130, 100, 32)
WHITE      = (242, 246, 250)
LGREY      = (148, 168, 188)
MGREY      = (68, 90, 115)
DGREY      = (24, 40, 62)
BAR_AI     = (0, 172, 172)
BAR_CLIN   = (42, 74, 116)
WARN       = (195, 62, 62)
WARN_BG    = (42, 10, 10)

def F(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def tw(d, text, font):
    bb = d.textbbox((0,0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2]-bb[0]

def wrap(d, text, x, y, max_w, font, color, lh, draw=True):
    words = text.split()
    line = ""
    for w in words:
        test = (line + " " + w).strip()
        if tw(d, test, font) <= max_w:
            line = test
        else:
            if line and draw:
                d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
            y += lh
            line = w
    if line and draw:
        d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
    if line:
        y += lh
    return y

def R(d, x1,y1,x2,y2,fill):
    d.rectangle([x1,y1,x2,y2], fill=fill)

def rule(d, x1, y, x2, color=None, h=2):
    R(d, x1, y, x2, y+h, color or DGREY)

def ctxt(d, text, cx, y, font, color):
    w = tw(d, text, font)
    d.text((cx - w//2, y), text, font=font, fill=color)

def sec_header(d, lx, ly, label, color=TEAL, accent=TEAL):
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+6, ly+54, accent)
    d.text((lx+20, ly), label, font=f_sec, fill=color)
    rule(d, lx, ly+64, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    return ly + 82

# ── Fonts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_venue   = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",  32)
f_h1      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf",   160)
f_h2      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  80)
f_h2i     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",   56)
f_sec     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   54)
f_sec_sm  = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   42)
f_body    = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",40)
f_body_sm = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",34)
f_body_xs = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",30)
f_mono    = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   34)
f_mono_sm = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   27)
f_mono_b  = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      48)
f_mono_b2 = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      40)
f_big     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",  310)
f_big2    = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",  200)
f_label   = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",36)
f_label_b = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   36)
f_tag     = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   25)
f_tag_sm  = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   21)

M  = 140
GS = 72
CW = (W - 2*M - GS) // 2
C1 = M
C2 = M + CW + GS

def make():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    d   = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # Subtle grid substrate
    for gx in range(0, W, 60):
        R(d, gx, 0, gx+1, H, (15, 25, 46))
    for gy in range(0, H, 60):
        R(d, 0, gy, W, gy+1, (15, 25, 46))

    # =========================================================
    # HEADER BAND
    # =========================================================
    R(d, 0, 0, W, 10, TEAL)

    y = 60
    d.text((M, y),
           "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM",
           font=f_venue, fill=TEAL)
    y += 56

    d.text((M, y), "Artificial Intelligence in", font=f_h1, fill=WHITE)
    y += 170
    d.text((M, y), "Clinical Decision-Making", font=f_h1, fill=TEAL)
    y += 176

    d.text((M, y), "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps",
           font=f_h2, fill=LGREY)
    y += 94

    d.text((M, y),
           "A synthesis of current evidence across >400 peer-reviewed studies on AI-assisted clinical decision support",
           font=f_h2i, fill=MGREY)
    y += 72

    rule(d, M, y, W-M, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    y += 40

    # =========================================================
    # ANCHOR STAT — <5% — full-width hero block
    # =========================================================
    ah = 420
    R(d, M-10, y-10, W-M+10, y+ah, NAVY_MID)
    R(d, M-10, y-10, M+5,    y+ah, GOLD)  # gold accent bar

    # Giant number
    d.text((M+36, y - 30), "<5%", font=f_big, fill=GOLD)

    # Descriptor to right
    dx = M + 36 + 700
    dy = y + 36
    d.text((dx, dy), "of published AI models", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 90
    d.text((dx, dy), "have undergone prospective", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 90
    d.text((dx, dy), "clinical validation", font=f_h2, fill=TEAL)
    dy += 102
    d.text((dx, dy),
           "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML medical devices  ·  fewer than 35 prospectively validated",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=LGREY)

    # Subtle horizontal scan lines inside block
    for sy in range(y+4, y+ah-4, 22):
        R(d, M+36, sy, W-M-10, sy+1, (0, 28, 38))

    y += ah + 6
    rule(d, M-10, y, W-M+10, GOLD_DIM, 2)
    y += 48

    # =========================================================
    # TWO-COLUMN BODY
    # =========================================================
    col_top = y

    # vertical separator (draw last to avoid overwriting)
    sep_x = C2 - GS//2

    # ── LEFT COLUMN ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    lx = C1
    ly = col_top

    # § 01 Background
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+6, ly+54, TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly), "01  BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, lx, ly+66, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ly += 88

    for para in [
        ("The integration of AI into clinical decision-making represents one of the most "
         "rapidly evolving frontiers in digital health. Despite promising results in "
         "controlled research settings, translation into routine clinical practice "
         "remains fundamentally limited."),
        ("This synthesis reviews evidence from a systematic assessment of >400 published "
         "studies evaluating AI-assisted diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic decision "
         "support across major clinical domains, published in The Lancet Digital Health."),
    ]:
        ly = wrap(d, para, lx, ly, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 48)
        ly += 26

    ly += 36

    # § 02 Diagnostic Performance
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+6, ly+54, TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly), "02  DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, lx, ly+66, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ly += 88

    # Paired sensitivity callouts — bigger
    bw = (CW - 30) // 2
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+bw, ly+200, (0, 38, 58))
    d.text((lx+20, ly+2), "87.5%", font=f_big2, fill=TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly+158), "AI Sensitivity", font=f_label_b, fill=TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly+176), "median, n>400 studies", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL_DIM)

    bx2 = lx + bw + 30
    R(d, bx2, ly, bx2+bw, ly+200, NAVY_LIGHT)
    d.text((bx2+20, ly+2), "78.2%", font=f_big2, fill=LGREY)
    d.text((bx2+20, ly+158), "Clinician Sensitivity", font=f_label_b, fill=LGREY)
    d.text((bx2+20, ly+176), "median, clinician-only", font=f_tag, fill=MGREY)
    ly += 220

    d.text((lx, ly), "+9.3 percentage-point diagnostic sensitivity gain",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=MGREY)
    ly += 54

    # Domain bar chart — taller bars, more breathing room
    domains = [
        ("Radiology",     89.3, 79.8),
        ("Dermatology",   86.7, 76.5),
        ("Ophthalmology", 90.1, 82.3),
        ("Pathology",     84.0, 74.1),
    ]
    lbl_w = 170
    bar_area = CW - lbl_w - 100
    scale = bar_area / 100.0
    BH = 26   # bar height
    BG2 = 10  # gap between paired bars

    for name, ai_v, cl_v in domains:
        d.text((lx, ly+4), name, font=f_label, fill=LGREY)
        bx = lx + lbl_w
        # clinician
        R(d, bx, ly, bx + int(cl_v*scale), ly + BH, BAR_CLIN)
        # ai
        R(d, bx, ly+BH+BG2, bx + int(ai_v*scale), ly+BH*2+BG2, BAR_AI)
        # values
        d.text((bx + int(ai_v*scale)+10, ly+BH+BG2),
               f"{ai_v}%", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL)
        d.text((bx + int(cl_v*scale)+10, ly),
               f"{cl_v}%", font=f_tag, fill=LGREY)
        ly += BH*2 + BG2 + 48

    # Legend
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+22, ly+14, BAR_AI)
    d.text((lx+30, ly-2), "AI-assisted", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL)
    R(d, lx+190, ly, lx+212, ly+14, BAR_CLIN)
    d.text((lx+220, ly-2), "Clinician-only", font=f_tag, fill=LGREY)
    ly += 44

    d.text((lx, ly), "Specificity: AI 93.1%  vs.  Clinician 91.4%",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=MGREY)
    ly += 52

    # Turnaround strip
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+CW, ly+70, TEAL_DARK)
    d.text((lx+20, ly+14),
           "↓ 32%    Reduction in diagnostic turnaround time",
           font=f_body, fill=TEAL)
    ly += 90

    left_bottom = ly

    # ── RIGHT COLUMN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    rx = C2
    ry = col_top

    # § 03 Safety
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+6, ry+54, WARN)
    d.text((rx+20, ry), "03  SAFETY, BIAS & EQUITY", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+66, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 88

    # 18% warning block
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+CW, ry+200, WARN_BG)
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+6,  ry+200, WARN)
    d.text((rx+22, ry - 16), "18%", font=f_big2, fill=WARN)
    d.text((rx+22, ry+152),
           "of studies reported any formal demographic bias assessment",
           font=f_label_b, fill=LGREY)
    ry += 220

    for para in [
        ("Among studies that did assess bias, performance disparities of 5–12 percentage "
         "points in sensitivity were documented for underrepresented populations — most "
         "strikingly in dermatology AI trained predominantly on lighter skin tones."),
        ("Adverse safety events attributable to AI recommendations were reported in <1% "
         "of prospective trials. Under-reporting is strongly suspected. No standardised "
         "safety-reporting framework for AI-CDSS currently exists."),
    ]:
        ry = wrap(d, para, rx, ry, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 48)
        ry += 26

    ry += 36

    # § 04 Implementation Gap
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+6, ry+54, GOLD)
    d.text((rx+20, ry), "04  TRANSLATIONAL GAP", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+66, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 88

    ry = wrap(d,
        "As of 2023, the FDA had cleared 692 AI/ML-enabled medical devices — yet "
        "fewer than 5% of peer-reviewed AI models have been prospectively validated "
        "in real-world clinical settings. This structural disconnect between publication "
        "volume and bedside deployment defines the translational crisis.",
        rx, ry, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 48)
    ry += 30

    barriers = [
        ("Data infrastructure",    "Fragmented EHR systems · lack of interoperability standards"),
        ("Regulatory uncertainty",  "Evolving frameworks that lag the pace of AI development"),
        ("Clinician trust",         "Insufficient explainability and transparency of model outputs"),
        ("Economic evidence",       "Limited cost-effectiveness analyses to justify investment"),
        ("Workflow integration",    "Poor alignment of AI tools with existing clinical workflows"),
    ]
    for title, desc in barriers:
        R(d, rx, ry, rx+3, ry+94, GOLD_DIM)
        d.text((rx+18, ry), title, font=f_sec_sm, fill=WHITE)
        ry += 48
        ry = wrap(d, desc, rx+18, ry, CW-20, f_body_sm, LGREY, 42)
        ry += 18

    ry += 34

    # § 05 Recommendations
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+6, ry+54, TEAL)
    d.text((rx+20, ry), "05  RECOMMENDATIONS", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+66, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 88

    recs = [
        ("R1", "Mandate prospective validation",
         "Multi-site, diverse-population trials required before clinical deployment"),
        ("R2", "Standardise bias auditing",
         "Demographic-stratified performance reporting as a mandatory publication requirement"),
        ("R3", "Shared safety registries",
         "Pharmacovigilance-analogous frameworks for AI-CDSS adverse event reporting"),
        ("R4", "Invest in interoperability",
         "Adopt open data standards: FHIR, OMOP across health system infrastructure"),
        ("R5", "Prioritise explainability",
         "Model transparency research to build clinician and patient trust in AI-augmented care"),
    ]
    for num, title, desc in recs:
        d.text((rx, ry), num, font=f_mono_b2, fill=GOLD)
        d.text((rx+74, ry), title, font=f_sec_sm, fill=WHITE)
        ry += 50
        ry = wrap(d, desc, rx+74, ry, CW-76, f_body_sm, LGREY, 42)
        ry += 18

    right_bottom = ry

    # ── Column separator ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    body_bottom = max(left_bottom, right_bottom) + 40
    R(d, sep_x, col_top, sep_x+1, body_bottom, DGREY)

    # =========================================================
    # FULL-WIDTH CLOSING QUOTE / CALL-TO-ACTION BAND
    # =========================================================
    cta_top = body_bottom + 40
    cta_h = 200
    R(d, M-10, cta_top, W-M+10, cta_top+cta_h, NAVY_MID)
    R(d, M-10, cta_top, M+5,    cta_top+cta_h, TEAL)
    rule(d, M-10, cta_top, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    quote = (
        "Closing the gap between AI research promise and clinical reality requires "
        "coordinated action across the research, regulatory, and healthcare delivery ecosystem."
    )
    ql = M + 36
    qy = cta_top + 30
    wrap(d, quote, ql, qy, W - 2*M - 46, f_h2i, LGREY, 72)

    rule(d, M-10, cta_top+cta_h, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    # =========================================================
    # BOTTOM METRICS STRIP
    # =========================================================
    strip_top = cta_top + cta_h + 50
    rule(d, M-10, strip_top, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    strip_top += 36

    metrics = [
        ("<5%",   "Prospective\nvalidation rate",       GOLD),
        ("87.5%", "AI diagnostic\nsensitivity",         TEAL),
        ("78.2%", "Clinician\nsensitivity",              LGREY),
        ("18%",   "Bias\nassessment\nreported",          WARN),
        ("32%↓",  "Turnaround\ntime reduction",          TEAL),
        ("692",   "FDA-cleared\nAI/ML devices",          LGREY),
    ]
    n = len(metrics)
    cell_w = (W - 2*M) // n
    for i, (val, lbl, col) in enumerate(metrics):
        cx = M + i*cell_w + cell_w//2
        if i > 0:
            R(d, M + i*cell_w, strip_top-10, M + i*cell_w+1, strip_top+220, DGREY)
        ctxt(d, val, cx, strip_top+10, f_mono_b, col)
        for j, line in enumerate(lbl.split("\n")):
            ctxt(d, line, cx, strip_top + 74 + j*32, f_tag, LGREY)

    strip_bottom = strip_top + 220

    rule(d, M-10, strip_bottom, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    # =========================================================
    # FOOTER
    # =========================================================
    foot_y = strip_bottom + 24
    d.text((M, foot_y),
           "Lancet Digital Health  ·  2023  ·  Systematic Review  ·  n > 400 studies",
           font=f_tag_sm, fill=MGREY)
    fr = "For research and educational use only"
    d.text((W - M - tw(d, fr, f_tag_sm), foot_y), fr, font=f_tag_sm, fill=MGREY)

    # =========================================================
    # DECORATIVE — Clinical Cartography
    # =========================================================
    # Concentric circles upper-right (data lens)
    cx0, cy0 = W - 180, 360
    for r, density in [(420, 3), (320, 3), (220, 4), (130, 5)]:
        steps = max(600, int(2 * math.pi * r / density))
        for s in range(steps):
            ang = 2 * math.pi * s / steps
            px = int(cx0 + r * math.cos(ang))
            py = int(cy0 + r * math.sin(ang))
            if 0 <= px < W and 0 <= py < H:
                d.point((px, py), fill=TEAL_DIM)

    # Thin horizontal scan lines inside anchor block
    for sy in range(col_top - 300, col_top - 300 + 420, 22):
        if sy > 0:
            R(d, M+36, sy, W-M-10, sy+1, (0, 25, 36))

    # Bottom teal bar
    R(d, 0, H-10, W, H, TEAL)

    return img, strip_bottom

if __name__ == "__main__":
    poster, sb = make()
    # Crop to used content + footer margin

    cropped.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Saved: {out}  ({cropped.width} x {cropped.height})  strip_bottom={sb}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic conference poster — VERSION 3 (full A0 canvas fill)
The Lancet Digital Health – AI in Clinical Medicine Symposium
Design philosophy: Clinical Cartography
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
W = 3370
H = 4764

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG         = (10, 18, 36)
NAVY_MID   = (14, 26, 50)
NAVY_LIGHT = (20, 36, 64)
TEAL       = (0, 172, 172)
TEAL_DIM   = (0, 100, 110)
TEAL_DARK  = (0, 50, 60)
GOLD       = (215, 168, 55)
GOLD_DIM   = (130, 100, 32)
WHITE      = (242, 246, 250)
LGREY      = (148, 168, 188)
MGREY      = (68, 90, 115)
DGREY      = (24, 40, 62)
BAR_AI     = (0, 172, 172)
BAR_CLIN   = (42, 74, 116)
WARN       = (195, 62, 62)
WARN_BG    = (42, 10, 10)

def F(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def tw(d, text, font):
    bb = d.textbbox((0,0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2]-bb[0]

def wrap(d, text, x, y, max_w, font, color, lh, draw=True):
    words = text.split()
    line = ""
    for w in words:
        test = (line + " " + w).strip()
        if tw(d, test, font) <= max_w:
            line = test
        else:
            if line and draw:
                d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
            y += lh
            line = w
    if line and draw:
        d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
    if line:
        y += lh
    return y

def R(d, x1,y1,x2,y2,fill):
    d.rectangle([x1,y1,x2,y2], fill=fill)

def rule(d, x1, y, x2, color=None, h=2):
    R(d, x1, y, x2, y+h, color or DGREY)

def ctxt(d, text, cx, y, font, color):
    w = tw(d, text, font)
    d.text((cx - w//2, y), text, font=font, fill=color)

def sec_header(d, lx, ly, label, color=TEAL, accent=TEAL):
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+6, ly+54, accent)
    d.text((lx+20, ly), label, font=f_sec, fill=color)
    rule(d, lx, ly+64, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    return ly + 82

# ── Fonts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_venue   = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",  32)
f_h1      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf",   160)
f_h2      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  80)
f_h2i     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",   56)
f_sec     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   54)
f_sec_sm  = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   42)
f_body    = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",40)
f_body_sm = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",34)
f_body_xs = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",30)

f_mono_b2 = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      40)

f_big2    = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",  200)

f_label_b = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   36)

def make():

    # =========================================================

    y += 56

    y += 170
    d.text((M, y), "Clinical Decision-Making", font=f_h1, fill=TEAL)
    y += 176

    y += 72

    rule(d, M, y, W-M, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    y += 40

    # =========================================================
    # ANCHOR STAT — <5% — full-width hero block
    # =========================================================
    ah = 420
    R(d, M-10, y-10, W-M+10, y+ah, NAVY_MID)
    R(d, M-10, y-10, M+5,    y+ah, GOLD)  # gold accent bar

    # Giant number
    d.text((M+36, y - 30), "<5%", font=f_big, fill=GOLD)

    # Descriptor to right
    dx = M + 36 + 700
    dy = y + 36
    d.text((dx, dy), "of published AI models", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 90
    d.text((dx, dy), "have undergone prospective", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 90
    d.text((dx, dy), "clinical validation", font=f_h2, fill=TEAL)
    dy += 102
    d.text((dx, dy),
           "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML medical devices  ·  fewer than 35 prospectively validated",

    rule(d, M-10, y, W-M+10, GOLD_DIM, 2)
    y += 48

    ly += 220

    d.text((lx, ly), "+9.3 percentage-point diagnostic sensitivity gain",

    ly += 54

    # Domain bar chart — taller bars, more breathing room

    lbl_w = 170

        bx = lx + lbl_w
        # clinician

        # ai
        R(d, bx, ly+BH+BG2, bx + int(ai_v*scale), ly+BH*2+BG2, BAR_AI)
        # values
        d.text((bx + int(ai_v*scale)+10, ly+BH+BG2),
               f"{ai_v}%", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL)
        d.text((bx + int(cl_v*scale)+10, ly),
               f"{cl_v}%", font=f_tag, fill=LGREY)
        ly += BH*2 + BG2 + 48

    # Legend
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+22, ly+14, BAR_AI)
    d.text((lx+30, ly-2), "AI-assisted", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL)
    R(d, lx+190, ly, lx+212, ly+14, BAR_CLIN)
    d.text((lx+220, ly-2), "Clinician-only", font=f_tag, fill=LGREY)
    ly += 44

    d.text((lx, ly), "Specificity: AI 93.1%  vs.  Clinician 91.4%",

    ly += 52

    d.text((lx+20, ly+14),

    ly += 90

    # ── RIGHT COLUMN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    ry = col_top

    # § 03 Safety

    d.text((rx+20, ry), "03  SAFETY, BIAS & EQUITY", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+66, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 88

    # 18% warning block
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+CW, ry+200, WARN_BG)
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+6,  ry+200, WARN)
    d.text((rx+22, ry - 16), "18%", font=f_big2, fill=WARN)
    d.text((rx+22, ry+152),

    ry += 220

    for para in [

        ry = wrap(d, para, rx, ry, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 48)

    d.text((rx+20, ry), "04  TRANSLATIONAL GAP", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+66, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 88

    ry = wrap(d,

    ry += 30

    barriers = [

        ry += 48
        ry = wrap(d, desc, rx+18, ry, CW-20, f_body_sm, LGREY, 42)

    # § 05 Recommendations

    d.text((rx+20, ry), "05  RECOMMENDATIONS", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+66, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 88

    recs = [

        ("R2", "Standardise bias auditing",
         "Demographic-stratified performance reporting as a mandatory publication requirement"),

        ("R4", "Invest in interoperability",
         "Adopt open data standards: FHIR, OMOP across health system infrastructure"),
        ("R5", "Prioritise explainability",
         "Model transparency research to build clinician and patient trust in AI-augmented care"),

    for num, title, desc in recs:
        d.text((rx, ry), num, font=f_mono_b2, fill=GOLD)
        d.text((rx+74, ry), title, font=f_sec_sm, fill=WHITE)
        ry += 50
        ry = wrap(d, desc, rx+74, ry, CW-76, f_body_sm, LGREY, 42)
        ry += 18

    right_bottom = ry

    # ── Column separator ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    body_bottom = max(left_bottom, right_bottom) + 40
    R(d, sep_x, col_top, sep_x+1, body_bottom, DGREY)

    # =========================================================
    # FULL-WIDTH CLOSING QUOTE / CALL-TO-ACTION BAND
    # =========================================================
    cta_top = body_bottom + 40
    cta_h = 200
    R(d, M-10, cta_top, W-M+10, cta_top+cta_h, NAVY_MID)
    R(d, M-10, cta_top, M+5,    cta_top+cta_h, TEAL)
    rule(d, M-10, cta_top, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    quote = (
        "Closing the gap between AI research promise and clinical reality requires "
        "coordinated action across the research, regulatory, and healthcare delivery ecosystem."
    )
    ql = M + 36
    qy = cta_top + 30
    wrap(d, quote, ql, qy, W - 2*M - 46, f_h2i, LGREY, 72)

    rule(d, M-10, cta_top+cta_h, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    # =========================================================
    # BOTTOM METRICS STRIP
    # =========================================================
    strip_top = cta_top + cta_h + 50
    rule(d, M-10, strip_top, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    strip_top += 36

    metrics = [
        ("<5%",   "Prospective\nvalidation rate",       GOLD),
        ("87.5%", "AI diagnostic\nsensitivity",         TEAL),
        ("78.2%", "Clinician\nsensitivity",              LGREY),
        ("18%",   "Bias\nassessment\nreported",          WARN),
        ("32%↓",  "Turnaround\ntime reduction",          TEAL),
        ("692",   "FDA-cleared\nAI/ML devices",          LGREY),
    ]
    n = len(metrics)
    cell_w = (W - 2*M) // n
    for i, (val, lbl, col) in enumerate(metrics):
        cx = M + i*cell_w + cell_w//2
        if i > 0:
            R(d, M + i*cell_w, strip_top-10, M + i*cell_w+1, strip_top+220, DGREY)
        ctxt(d, val, cx, strip_top+10, f_mono_b, col)
        for j, line in enumerate(lbl.split("\n")):
            ctxt(d, line, cx, strip_top + 74 + j*32, f_tag, LGREY)

    strip_bottom = strip_top + 220

    rule(d, M-10, strip_bottom, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    # =========================================================
    # FOOTER
    # =========================================================
    foot_y = strip_bottom + 24
    d.text((M, foot_y),
           "Lancet Digital Health  ·  2023  ·  Systematic Review  ·  n > 400 studies",
           font=f_tag_sm, fill=MGREY)
    fr = "For research and educational use only"
    d.text((W - M - tw(d, fr, f_tag_sm), foot_y), fr, font=f_tag_sm, fill=MGREY)

    # =========================================================
    # DECORATIVE — Clinical Cartography
    # =========================================================
    # Concentric circles upper-right (data lens)
    cx0, cy0 = W - 180, 360
    for r, density in [(420, 3), (320, 3), (220, 4), (130, 5)]:
        steps = max(600, int(2 * math.pi * r / density))
        for s in range(steps):
            ang = 2 * math.pi * s / steps
            px = int(cx0 + r * math.cos(ang))
            py = int(cy0 + r * math.sin(ang))
            if 0 <= px < W and 0 <= py < H:
                d.point((px, py), fill=TEAL_DIM)

    # Thin horizontal scan lines inside anchor block
    for sy in range(col_top - 300, col_top - 300 + 420, 22):
        if sy > 0:
            R(d, M+36, sy, W-M-10, sy+1, (0, 25, 36))

    # Bottom teal bar
    R(d, 0, H-10, W, H, TEAL)

    return img, strip_bottom

if __name__ == "__main__":
    poster, sb = make()
    # Crop to used content + footer margin
    crop_bottom = min(sb + 110, H)
    cropped = poster.crop((0, 0, W, crop_bottom))
    out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
    cropped.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Saved: {out}  ({cropped.width} x {cropped.height})  strip_bottom={sb}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic conference poster — FINAL REFINED VERSION
The Lancet Digital Health – AI in Clinical Medicine Symposium
Design philosophy: Clinical Cartography
Second-pass: tighter craft, larger type, refined spacing, stronger visual hierarchy
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
W = 3370
H = 4764

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG         = (9, 17, 34)
NAVY_MID   = (14, 26, 50)
NAVY_LIGHT = (19, 34, 62)
TEAL       = (0, 174, 174)
TEAL_DIM   = (0, 100, 108)
TEAL_DARK  = (0, 46, 56)
GOLD       = (218, 170, 52)
GOLD_DIM   = (128, 98, 30)
GOLD_PALE  = (255, 220, 120)
WHITE      = (240, 245, 250)
LGREY      = (144, 166, 186)
MGREY      = (64, 88, 112)
DGREY      = (22, 38, 60)
BAR_AI     = (0, 174, 174)
BAR_CLIN   = (38, 70, 112)
WARN       = (192, 58, 58)
WARN_BG    = (38, 8, 8)

def F(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def tw(d, text, font):
    bb = d.textbbox((0,0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2]-bb[0]

def wrap(d, text, x, y, max_w, font, color, lh):
    words = text.split()
    line = ""
    for w in words:
        test = (line + " " + w).strip()
        if tw(d, test, font) <= max_w:
            line = test
        else:
            if line:
                d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
            y += lh
            line = w
    if line:
        d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
        y += lh
    return y

def R(d, x1,y1,x2,y2,fill):
    d.rectangle([int(x1),int(y1),int(x2),int(y2)], fill=fill)

def rule(d, x1, y, x2, color=None, h=2):
    R(d, x1, y, x2, y+h, color or DGREY)

def ctxt(d, text, cx, y, font, color):
    w = tw(d, text, font)
    d.text((int(cx - w//2), int(y)), text, font=font, fill=color)

# ── Fonts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_venue   = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",  34)
f_h1      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf",   170)
f_h2      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  86)
f_h2i     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",   58)
f_sec     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   56)
f_sec_sm  = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   44)
f_body    = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",42)
f_body_sm = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",36)
f_mono    = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   36)
f_mono_sm = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   28)
f_mono_b  = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      50)
f_mono_b2 = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      42)
f_big     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",  330)
f_big2    = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",  210)
f_label   = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",38)
f_label_b = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   38)
f_tag     = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   26)
f_tag_sm  = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   22)

M  = 145
GS = 76
CW = (W - 2*M - GS) // 2
C1 = M
C2 = M + CW + GS

def make():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    d   = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # Substrate grid
    for gx in range(0, W, 58):
        R(d, gx, 0, gx+1, H, (14, 24, 44))
    for gy in range(0, H, 58):
        R(d, 0, gy, W, gy+1, (14, 24, 44))

    # =========================================================
    # HEADER
    # =========================================================
    R(d, 0, 0, W, 12, TEAL)

    y = 62
    d.text((M, y),
           "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM",
           font=f_venue, fill=TEAL)
    y += 60

    d.text((M, y), "Artificial Intelligence in", font=f_h1, fill=WHITE)
    y += 182
    d.text((M, y), "Clinical Decision-Making", font=f_h1, fill=TEAL)
    y += 186

    d.text((M, y), "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps",
           font=f_h2, fill=LGREY)
    y += 100

    d.text((M, y),
           "A synthesis of current evidence across >400 peer-reviewed studies on AI-assisted clinical decision support",
           font=f_h2i, fill=MGREY)
    y += 76

    rule(d, M, y, W-M, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    y += 44

    # =========================================================
    # ANCHOR STAT — <5%
    # =========================================================
    ah = 440
    R(d, M-10, y-10, W-M+10, y+ah, NAVY_MID)
    R(d, M-10, y-10, M+6,    y+ah, GOLD)

    # Faint scan lines inside block
    for sy in range(y, y+ah, 20):
        R(d, M+8, sy, W-M-10, sy+1, (0, 24, 34))

    # Giant "<5%"
    d.text((M+38, y-36), "<5%", font=f_big, fill=GOLD)

    # Descriptor
    dx = M + 38 + 740
    dy = y + 42
    d.text((dx, dy), "of published AI models", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 96
    d.text((dx, dy), "have undergone prospective", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 96
    d.text((dx, dy), "clinical validation", font=f_h2, fill=TEAL)
    dy += 108
    d.text((dx, dy),
           "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML medical devices  ·  fewer than 35 prospectively validated",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=LGREY)

    y += ah + 8
    rule(d, M-10, y, W-M+10, GOLD_DIM, 2)
    y += 52

    # =========================================================
    # TWO-COLUMN BODY
    # =========================================================
    col_top = y
    sep_x   = C2 - GS//2

    # ── LEFT COLUMN ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    lx = C1
    ly = col_top

    # § 01 Background
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+7, ly+56, TEAL)
    d.text((lx+22, ly), "01  BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, lx, ly+68, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ly += 90

    for para in [
        ("The integration of AI into clinical decision-making represents one of the most "
         "rapidly evolving frontiers in digital health. Despite promising results in "
         "controlled research settings, translation into routine clinical practice "
         "remains fundamentally limited."),
        ("This synthesis reviews evidence from a systematic assessment of >400 published "
         "studies evaluating AI-assisted diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic decision "
         "support across major clinical domains, published in The Lancet Digital Health."),
    ]:
        ly = wrap(d, para, lx, ly, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 50)
        ly += 28

    ly += 42

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Academic conference poster — FINAL REFINED VERSION
The Lancet Digital Health – AI in Clinical Medicine Symposium
Design philosophy: Clinical Cartography
Second-pass: tighter craft, larger type, refined spacing, stronger visual hierarchy
"""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import math, os

FONT_DIR = "/logs/agent/sessions/skills/canvas-design/canvas-fonts"
W = 3370
H = 4764

# ── Palette ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
BG         = (9, 17, 34)
NAVY_MID   = (14, 26, 50)
NAVY_LIGHT = (19, 34, 62)
TEAL       = (0, 174, 174)
TEAL_DIM   = (0, 100, 108)
TEAL_DARK  = (0, 46, 56)
GOLD       = (218, 170, 52)
GOLD_DIM   = (128, 98, 30)
GOLD_PALE  = (255, 220, 120)
WHITE      = (240, 245, 250)
LGREY      = (144, 166, 186)
MGREY      = (64, 88, 112)
DGREY      = (22, 38, 60)
BAR_AI     = (0, 174, 174)
BAR_CLIN   = (38, 70, 112)
WARN       = (192, 58, 58)
WARN_BG    = (38, 8, 8)

def F(name, size):
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(os.path.join(FONT_DIR, name), size)
    except:
        return ImageFont.load_default()

def tw(d, text, font):
    bb = d.textbbox((0,0), text, font=font)
    return bb[2]-bb[0]

def wrap(d, text, x, y, max_w, font, color, lh):
    words = text.split()
    line = ""
    for w in words:
        test = (line + " " + w).strip()
        if tw(d, test, font) <= max_w:
            line = test
        else:
            if line:
                d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
            y += lh
            line = w
    if line:
        d.text((x, y), line, font=font, fill=color)
        y += lh
    return y

def R(d, x1,y1,x2,y2,fill):
    d.rectangle([int(x1),int(y1),int(x2),int(y2)], fill=fill)

def rule(d, x1, y, x2, color=None, h=2):
    R(d, x1, y, x2, y+h, color or DGREY)

def ctxt(d, text, cx, y, font, color):
    w = tw(d, text, font)
    d.text((int(cx - w//2), int(y)), text, font=font, fill=color)

# ── Fonts ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
f_venue   = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",  34)
f_h1      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Bold.ttf",   170)
f_h2      = F("IBMPlexSerif-Regular.ttf",  86)
f_h2i     = F("IBMPlexSerif-Italic.ttf",   58)
f_sec     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   56)
f_sec_sm  = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   44)
f_body    = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",42)
f_body_sm = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",36)
f_mono    = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   36)
f_mono_sm = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   28)
f_mono_b  = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      50)
f_mono_b2 = F("IBMPlexMono-Bold.ttf",      42)
f_big     = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",  330)
f_big2    = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",  210)
f_label   = F("InstrumentSans-Regular.ttf",38)
f_label_b = F("InstrumentSans-Bold.ttf",   38)
f_tag     = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   26)
f_tag_sm  = F("IBMPlexMono-Regular.ttf",   22)

M  = 145
GS = 76
CW = (W - 2*M - GS) // 2
C1 = M
C2 = M + CW + GS

def make():
    img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
    d   = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    # Substrate grid
    for gx in range(0, W, 58):
        R(d, gx, 0, gx+1, H, (14, 24, 44))
    for gy in range(0, H, 58):
        R(d, 0, gy, W, gy+1, (14, 24, 44))

    # =========================================================
    # HEADER
    # =========================================================
    R(d, 0, 0, W, 12, TEAL)

    y = 62
    d.text((M, y),
           "THE LANCET DIGITAL HEALTH  ·  AI IN CLINICAL MEDICINE SYMPOSIUM",
           font=f_venue, fill=TEAL)
    y += 60

    d.text((M, y), "Artificial Intelligence in", font=f_h1, fill=WHITE)
    y += 182
    d.text((M, y), "Clinical Decision-Making", font=f_h1, fill=TEAL)
    y += 186

    d.text((M, y), "Performance, Safety, and Implementation Gaps",
           font=f_h2, fill=LGREY)
    y += 100

    d.text((M, y),
           "A synthesis of current evidence across >400 peer-reviewed studies on AI-assisted clinical decision support",
           font=f_h2i, fill=MGREY)
    y += 76

    rule(d, M, y, W-M, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    y += 44

    # =========================================================
    # ANCHOR STAT — <5%
    # =========================================================
    ah = 440
    R(d, M-10, y-10, W-M+10, y+ah, NAVY_MID)
    R(d, M-10, y-10, M+6,    y+ah, GOLD)

    # Faint scan lines inside block
    for sy in range(y, y+ah, 20):
        R(d, M+8, sy, W-M-10, sy+1, (0, 24, 34))

    # Giant "<5%"
    d.text((M+38, y-36), "<5%", font=f_big, fill=GOLD)

    # Descriptor
    dx = M + 38 + 740
    dy = y + 42
    d.text((dx, dy), "of published AI models", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 96
    d.text((dx, dy), "have undergone prospective", font=f_h2, fill=WHITE)
    dy += 96
    d.text((dx, dy), "clinical validation", font=f_h2, fill=TEAL)
    dy += 108
    d.text((dx, dy),
           "692 FDA-cleared AI/ML medical devices  ·  fewer than 35 prospectively validated",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=LGREY)

    y += ah + 8
    rule(d, M-10, y, W-M+10, GOLD_DIM, 2)
    y += 52

    # =========================================================
    # TWO-COLUMN BODY
    # =========================================================
    col_top = y
    sep_x   = C2 - GS//2

    # ── LEFT COLUMN ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    lx = C1
    ly = col_top

    # § 01 Background
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+7, ly+56, TEAL)
    d.text((lx+22, ly), "01  BACKGROUND & MOTIVATION", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, lx, ly+68, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ly += 90

    for para in [
        ("The integration of AI into clinical decision-making represents one of the most "
         "rapidly evolving frontiers in digital health. Despite promising results in "
         "controlled research settings, translation into routine clinical practice "
         "remains fundamentally limited."),
        ("This synthesis reviews evidence from a systematic assessment of >400 published "
         "studies evaluating AI-assisted diagnosis, prognosis, and therapeutic decision "
         "support across major clinical domains, published in The Lancet Digital Health."),
    ]:
        ly = wrap(d, para, lx, ly, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 50)
        ly += 28

    ly += 42

    # § 02 Diagnostic Performance
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+7, ly+56, TEAL)
    d.text((lx+22, ly), "02  DIAGNOSTIC PERFORMANCE", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, lx, ly+68, lx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ly += 90

    # Paired sensitivity callouts
    bw = (CW - 32) // 2
    R(d, lx, ly, lx+bw, ly+214, (0, 36, 56))
    d.text((lx+20, ly), "87.5%", font=f_big2, fill=TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly+168), "AI Sensitivity", font=f_label_b, fill=TEAL)
    d.text((lx+20, ly+188), "median, n>400 studies", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL_DIM)

    bx2 = lx + bw + 32
    R(d, bx2, ly, bx2+bw, ly+214, NAVY_LIGHT)
    d.text((bx2+20, ly), "78.2%", font=f_big2, fill=LGREY)
    d.text((bx2+20, ly+168), "Clinician Sensitivity", font=f_label_b, fill=LGREY)
    d.text((bx2+20, ly+188), "median, clinician-only", font=f_tag, fill=MGREY)
    ly += 234

    d.text((lx, ly), "+9.3 pp diagnostic sensitivity gain  ·  >400 studies",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=MGREY)
    ly += 58

    # Bar chart
    domains = [
        ("Radiology",     89.3, 79.8),
        ("Dermatology",   86.7, 76.5),
        ("Ophthalmology", 90.1, 82.3),
        ("Pathology",     84.0, 74.1),
    ]
    lbl_w  = 174
    bar_area = CW - lbl_w - 110
    scale  = bar_area / 100.0
    BH, BG3 = 28, 10

    for name, ai_v, cl_v in domains:
        d.text((lx, ly+4), name, font=f_label, fill=LGREY)
        bx = lx + lbl_w
        R(d, bx, ly, bx + int(cl_v*scale), ly+BH, BAR_CLIN)
        R(d, bx, ly+BH+BG3, bx + int(ai_v*scale), ly+BH*2+BG3, BAR_AI)
        d.text((bx + int(ai_v*scale)+10, ly+BH+BG3), f"{ai_v}%", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL)
        d.text((bx + int(cl_v*scale)+10, ly), f"{cl_v}%", font=f_tag, fill=LGREY)
        ly += BH*2 + BG3 + 52

    R(d, lx, ly, lx+24, ly+14, BAR_AI)
    d.text((lx+32, ly-2), "AI-assisted", font=f_tag, fill=TEAL)
    R(d, lx+202, ly, lx+226, ly+14, BAR_CLIN)
    d.text((lx+234, ly-2), "Clinician-only", font=f_tag, fill=LGREY)
    ly += 46

    d.text((lx, ly), "Specificity: AI 93.1%  vs.  Clinician 91.4%",
           font=f_mono_sm, fill=MGREY)
    ly += 56

    R(d, lx, ly, lx+CW, ly+74, TEAL_DARK)
    d.text((lx+20, ly+16),
           "↓ 32%    Reduction in diagnostic turnaround time with AI assistance",
           font=f_body, fill=TEAL)
    ly += 96

    left_bottom = ly

    # ── RIGHT COLUMN ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    rx = C2
    ry = col_top

    # § 03 Safety
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+7, ry+56, WARN)
    d.text((rx+22, ry), "03  SAFETY, BIAS & EQUITY", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+68, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 90

    # 18% warning block
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+CW, ry+214, WARN_BG)
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+7,  ry+214, WARN)
    d.text((rx+22, ry-22), "18%", font=f_big2, fill=WARN)
    d.text((rx+22, ry+162),
           "of studies reported any formal demographic bias assessment",
           font=f_label_b, fill=LGREY)
    ry += 234

    for para in [
        ("Among studies that did assess bias, performance disparities of 5–12 percentage "
         "points in sensitivity were documented for underrepresented populations — most "
         "strikingly in dermatology AI trained predominantly on lighter skin tones."),
        ("Adverse safety events attributable to AI recommendations were reported in <1% "
         "of prospective trials. Under-reporting is strongly suspected. No standardised "
         "safety-reporting framework for AI-CDSS currently exists."),
    ]:
        ry = wrap(d, para, rx, ry, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 50)
        ry += 28

    ry += 42

    # § 04 Translational Gap
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+7, ry+56, GOLD)
    d.text((rx+22, ry), "04  TRANSLATIONAL GAP", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+68, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 90

    ry = wrap(d,
        "As of 2023, the FDA had cleared 692 AI/ML-enabled medical devices — yet "
        "fewer than 5% of peer-reviewed AI models have been prospectively validated "
        "in real-world clinical settings. This structural disconnect between publication "
        "volume and bedside deployment defines the translational crisis.",
        rx, ry, CW, f_body_sm, LGREY, 50)
    ry += 34

    barriers = [
        ("Data infrastructure",    "Fragmented EHR systems · lack of interoperability standards"),
        ("Regulatory uncertainty",  "Evolving frameworks that lag the pace of AI development"),
        ("Clinician trust",         "Insufficient explainability and transparency of model outputs"),
        ("Economic evidence",       "Limited cost-effectiveness analyses to justify investment"),

    ]

        R(d, rx, ry, rx+4, ry+98, GOLD_DIM)
        d.text((rx+20, ry), title, font=f_sec_sm, fill=WHITE)
        ry += 50
        ry = wrap(d, desc, rx+20, ry, CW-22, f_body_sm, LGREY, 44)
        ry += 20

    ry += 38

    # § 05 Recommendations
    R(d, rx, ry, rx+7, ry+56, TEAL)
    d.text((rx+22, ry), "05  RECOMMENDATIONS", font=f_sec, fill=TEAL)
    rule(d, rx, ry+68, rx+CW, DGREY, 1)
    ry += 90

    recs = [
        ("R1", "Mandate prospective validation",
         "Multi-site, diverse-population trials required before clinical deployment"),
        ("R2", "Standardise bias auditing",
         "Demographic-stratified performance reporting as a mandatory publication requirement"),
        ("R3", "Shared safety registries",
         "Pharmacovigilance-analogous frameworks for AI-CDSS adverse event reporting"),
        ("R4", "Invest in interoperability",
         "Adopt open data standards: FHIR, OMOP across health system infrastructure"),
        ("R5", "Prioritise explainability",
         "Model transparency research to build clinician and patient trust in AI-augmented care"),
    ]
    for num, title, desc in recs:
        d.text((rx, ry), num, font=f_mono_b2, fill=GOLD)
        d.text((rx+78, ry), title, font=f_sec_sm, fill=WHITE)
        ry += 52
        ry = wrap(d, desc, rx+78, ry, CW-80, f_body_sm, LGREY, 44)
        ry += 20

    right_bottom = ry

    # ── Column separator ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
    body_bottom = max(left_bottom, right_bottom) + 48
    R(d, sep_x, col_top, sep_x+1, body_bottom, DGREY)

    # =========================================================
    # FULL-WIDTH CLOSING BAND
    # =========================================================
    ct = body_bottom + 44
    ch = 210
    R(d, M-10, ct, W-M+10, ct+ch, NAVY_MID)
    R(d, M-10, ct, M+6,    ct+ch, TEAL)
    rule(d, M-10, ct, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    rule(d, M-10, ct+ch, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    quote = (
        "Closing the gap between AI research promise and clinical reality requires "
        "coordinated action across the research, regulatory, and healthcare delivery ecosystem."
    )
    wrap(d, quote, M+38, ct+38, W-2*M-48, f_h2i, LGREY, 76)

    # =========================================================
    # BOTTOM METRICS STRIP
    # =========================================================
    st = ct + ch + 52
    rule(d, M-10, st, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)
    st += 38

    metrics = [
        ("<5%",   "Prospective\nvalidation rate",    GOLD),
        ("87.5%", "AI diagnostic\nsensitivity",      TEAL),
        ("78.2%", "Clinician\nsensitivity",           LGREY),
        ("18%",   "Bias\nassessment\nreported",       WARN),
        ("32%↓",  "Turnaround\ntime reduction",       TEAL),
        ("692",   "FDA-cleared\nAI/ML devices",       LGREY),
    ]
    cell_w = (W - 2*M) // len(metrics)
    for i, (val, lbl, col) in enumerate(metrics):
        cx = M + i*cell_w + cell_w//2
        if i > 0:
            R(d, M + i*cell_w, st-10, M + i*cell_w+1, st+230, DGREY)
        ctxt(d, val, cx, st+12, f_mono_b, col)
        for j, line in enumerate(lbl.split("\n")):
            ctxt(d, line, cx, st+76 + j*34, f_tag, LGREY)

    sb = st + 232
    rule(d, M-10, sb, W-M+10, TEAL_DIM, 2)

    # =========================================================
    # FOOTER
    # =========================================================
    fy = sb + 26
    d.text((M, fy),
           "Lancet Digital Health  ·  2023  ·  Systematic Review  ·  n > 400 studies",
           font=f_tag_sm, fill=MGREY)
    fr = "For research and educational use only"
    d.text((W - M - tw(d, fr, f_tag_sm), fy), fr, font=f_tag_sm, fill=MGREY)

    # =========================================================
    # DECORATIVE — Clinical Cartography
    # =========================================================
    # Data lens circles, upper right corner
    cx0, cy0 = W - 160, 380
    for r in [440, 340, 240, 144]:
        steps = max(800, int(2 * math.pi * r / 2.8))
        for s in range(steps):
            ang = 2 * math.pi * s / steps
            px = int(cx0 + r * math.cos(ang))
            py = int(cy0 + r * math.sin(ang))
            if 0 <= px < W and 0 <= py < H:
                d.point((px, py), fill=TEAL_DIM)

    # Second smaller data lens, lower left
    cx1, cy1 = 120, body_bottom + ch//2 + 44
    for r in [180, 120, 70]:
        steps = max(500, int(2 * math.pi * r / 2.5))
        for s in range(steps):
            ang = 2 * math.pi * s / steps
            px = int(cx1 + r * math.cos(ang))
            py = int(cy1 + r * math.sin(ang))
            if 0 <= px < W and 0 <= py < H:
                d.point((px, py), fill=GOLD_DIM)

    # Bottom rule
    R(d, 0, H-12, W, H, TEAL)

    return img, sb, fy

if __name__ == "__main__":
    poster, sb, fy = make()
    crop_bottom = min(fy + 80, H)
    cropped = poster.crop((0, 0, W, crop_bottom))
    out = "/app/output/final_poster.png"
    cropped.save(out, "PNG", dpi=(150, 150))
    print(f"Saved: {out}  ({cropped.width} x {cropped.height})")
